story.text: 함덕해수욕장의 에메랄드빛 바다 앞, 용우가 파라솔을 펴며 자리를 잡는다.
story.reading: ham-deok-hae-su-yok-jang-ui e-me-ral-deu-bit ba-da ap, yong-u-ga pa-ra-sol-eul pyeo-myeo ja-ri-reul jap-neun-da.
story.en: In front of Hamdeok Beach's emerald sea, Yongwoo sets up a spot, unfolding a parasol.

story.text: '이 백사장 밟아본 지 오랜만이네. 너랑 오니까 또 느낌이 다르다.' (헛기침) '…경치가, 경치가 다르다고.'
story.reading: i baek-sa-jang balb-a-bon ji o-raen-man-i-ne. neo-rang o-ni-kka tto neu-kkim-i da-reu-da. gyeong-chi-ga, gyeong-chi-ga da-reu-da-go.
story.en: 'It's been a while since I walked this white sand. Coming here with you feels different.' (clears throat) '...I meant the scenery. The scenery's different.'

story.text: 옆 파라솔에 있던 손님 무리가 용우를 알아보고 수군거린다. '저분, K-MATE 인기 기장 두 분 중 한 분 아니야? 규현 기장님이랑 맨날 같이 묶여서 나오는.' 용우의 눈썹이 미세하게 꿈틀했다.
story.reading: yeop pa-ra-sol-e it-deon son-nim mu-ri-ga yong-u-reul al-a-bo-go su-gun-geo-rin-da. jeo-bun, k-me-i-teu in-gi gi-jang du bun jung han bun a-ni-ya? gyu-hyeon gi-jang-nim-i-rang maen-nal gat-i mu-kkyeo-seo na-o-neun. yong-u-ui nun-sseob-i mi-se-ha-ge kkum-teul-haet-da.
story.en: A group at the next parasol over recognized Yongwoo and whispered among themselves. 'Isn't that one of the two popular K-MATE captains? The one who's always lumped in with Captain Kyuhyun.' Yongwoo's eyebrow twitched, ever so slightly.

story.text: '묶이긴 뭘 묶여. 걔랑 나랑 같은 급이 아닌데.' 누구 들으라는 것도 아닌데 혼자 중얼거리며 파라솔 각도를 신경질적으로 고쳐 세운다.
story.reading: mu-kkyeo-gin mwol mu-kkyeo. gyae-rang na-rang gat-eun geub-i a-nin-de. nu-gu deul-eu-ra-neun geot-do a-nin-de hon-ja jung-eol-geo-ri-myeo pa-ra-sol gak-do-reul sin-gyeong-jil-jeog-eu-ro go-chyeo se-un-da.
story.en: 'Lumped in, my foot. He and I aren't even in the same league.' Muttering to no one in particular, he re-adjusts the parasol angle with unnecessary force.

story.text: 옆에서 낯선 남자가 말을 걸자, 용우가 은근히 내 앞으로 자리를 옮겨 앉는다. '왜 자꾸 말 걸어, 저 사람.'
story.reading: yeop-e-seo nat-seon nam-ja-ga mal-eul geol-ja, yong-u-ga eun-geun-hi nae ap-eu-ro ja-ri-reul om-gyeo anj-neun-da. wae ja-kku mal geol-eo, jeo sa-ram.
story.en: When a stranger nearby starts talking to me, Yongwoo subtly shifts his seat in front of me. 'Why does that guy keep talking to you.'

story.text: '신경 쓰지 말고 내 곁에 있어라. 내가 있는데 뭐가 걱정이야.' 말은 무심한 척, 눈은 이미 그 남자를 노려보고 있다. 팔짱을 낀 어깨가 유독 단단해 보였다.
story.reading: sin-gyeong sseu-ji mal-go nae gyeot-e iss-eo-ra. nae-ga it-neun-de mwo-ga geok-jeong-i-ya. mal-eun mu-sim-han cheok, nun-eun i-mi geu nam-ja-reul no-ryeo-bo-go it-da. pal-jjang-eul kkin eo-kkae-ga yu-dok dan-dan-hae bo-yeot-da.
story.en: 'Don't worry about him, just stay by my side. What's there to worry about when I'm here.' His words sound indifferent, but his eyes are already glaring at the man. His crossed arms looked unusually solid just then.

story.text: '됐고, 동생 챙기는 건 나뿐이지. 규현이는 신경도 안 쓰거든? 딴생각 말고 이 대화들이나 잘 들어봐라.'
story.reading: dwaet-go, dong-saeng chaeng-gi-neun geon na-ppun-i-ji. gyu-hyeon-i-neun sin-gyeong-do an sseu-geo-deun. ttan-saeng-gak mal-go i dae-hwa-deul-i-na jal deul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: 'Never mind. I'm the only one who looks out for you, got it? Kyuhyun wouldn't even bother. Stop overthinking and listen to these conversations carefully.'

words.example_en: Hamdeok's white sand beach is famous for its clear water color.

words.example: 힘들 때마다 그가 늘 내 곁에 있어주었다.
words.example_reading: him-deul ttae-ma-da geu-ga neul nae gyeot-e iss-eo-ju-eot-da
words.example_en: Whenever things were hard, he always stayed by my side.

words.meaning: To strike up a conversation, talk to someone
words.example: 낯선 사람이 갑자기 나에게 말을 걸었다.
words.example_reading: nat-seon sa-ram-i gap-ja-gi na-e-ge mal-eul geol-eot-da
words.example_en: A stranger suddenly struck up a conversation with me.

words.meaning: To whisper, gossip in low voices
words.example_en: People recognized him and whispered among themselves.

words.meaning: To be on a different level (idiom, often boastful)
words.example: 그는 자기 인기가 남들과 급이 다르다고 우겼다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun ja-gi in-gi-ga nam-deul-gwa geub-i da-reu-da-go u-gyeot-da
words.example_en: He insisted his popularity was on a completely different level from everyone else's.

sentences.ko: 함덕해수욕장의 백사장은 오랜만에 밟아도 여전히 곱고 하얬다.
sentences.reading: ham-deok-hae-su-yok-jang-ui baek-sa-jang-eun o-raen-man-e balb-a-do yeo-jeon-hi gop-go ha-yaet-da
sentences.en: Even after a long time, the white sand of Hamdeok Beach was still fine and white.

sentences.ko: 옆자리 손님들이 그를 알아보고 규현 기장과 묶어 수군거렸다.
sentences.reading: yeop-ja-ri son-nim-deul-i geu-reul al-a-bo-go gyu-hyeon gi-jang-gwa mu-kkeo su-gun-geo-ryeot-da
sentences.en: The passengers nearby recognized him and whispered, lumping him together with Captain Kyuhyun.

sentences.ko: 그는 급이 다르다며 혼자 중얼거리고는 애꿎은 파라솔만 고쳐 세웠다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun geub-i da-reu-da-myeo hon-ja jung-eol-geo-ri-go-neun ae-kkuj-eun pa-ra-sol-man go-chyeo se-wot-da
sentences.en: Muttering that he was on a different level entirely, he took it out on the parasol instead.

sentences.ko: 낯선 남자가 말을 걸자 그는 은근히 내 앞으로 자리를 옮겼다.
sentences.reading: nat-seon nam-ja-ga mal-eul geol-ja geu-neun eun-geun-hi nae ap-eu-ro ja-ri-reul om-gyeot-da
sentences.en: When a stranger spoke to me, he subtly moved to sit in front of me.

sentences.ko: 신경 쓰지 말고 내 곁에 있으라는 그의 말이 오래도록 남았다.
sentences.reading: sin-gyeong sseu-ji mal-go nae gyeot-e iss-eu-ra-neun geu-ui mal-i o-rae-do-rok nam-at-da
sentences.en: His words, telling me to stay by his side and not worry, lingered for a long time.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 방금 저기 사람들이 기장님 보고 수군거리던데요, 인기 많으신가 봐요?
turns.reading: bang-geum jeo-gi sa-ram-deul-i gi-jang-nim bo-go su-gun-geo-ri-deon-de-yo, in-gi man-eu-sin-ga bwa-yo?
turns.en: Those people over there were just whispering about you, Captain. You must be popular.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 규현이랑 헷갈렸겠지, 뭐. 사람들이 자꾸 우리 둘을 묶어서 말해서.
turns.reading: gyu-hyeon-i-rang heot-gal-lyeot-get-ji, mwo. sa-ram-deul-i ja-kku u-ri dul-eul mu-kkeo-seo mal-hae-seo.
turns.en: They probably mixed me up with Kyuhyun. People keep lumping the two of us together.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 두 분이 같이 묶이는 게 싫으세요?
turns.reading: du bun-i gat-i mu-kki-neun ge sil-eo-yo?
turns.en: Do you dislike being grouped with him?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 싫다기보다는… 급이 다른데 자꾸 그러니까 그렇지.
turns.reading: sil-ta-gi-bo-da-neun, geub-i da-reun-de ja-kku geu-reo-ni-kka geu-reo-chi.
turns.en: It's not that I dislike it exactly... it's just that we're on different levels, and they keep doing it anyway.

dialogues.question: 용우가 규현과 묶이는 것에 예민하게 반응한 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Yongwoo react touchily to being lumped together with Kyuhyun?
dialogues.correct_answer: 자신의 인기가 규현과는 다른 급이라고 은근히 생각해서
options: 자신의 인기가 규현과는 다른 급이라고 은근히 생각해서
손님이 규현을 더 좋아할까 봐 걱정돼서
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 규현과 자신이 같은 급으로 묶이는 걸 은근히 못마땅해하며, 자기 인기가 더 특별하다고 생각하는 승부욕을 드러냈습니다.

turns.speaker: 낯선 남자
turns.text: 저기, 혹시 시간 있으시면 같이 사진 좀…
turns.reading: jeo-gi, hok-si si-gan iss-eu-si-myeon gat-i sa-jin jom.
turns.en: Excuse me, if you have a moment, could we take a photo together...

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: kki-eo-deul-myeo, yae ji-geum na-rang gat-i it-neun-de-yo.
turns.en: (cutting in) She's with me right now.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 왜 끼어들어요, 그냥 사진 찍자는 거였는데.
turns.reading: wae kki-eo-deul-eo-yo, geu-nyang sa-jin jjik-ja-neun geo-yeot-neun-de.
turns.en: Why'd you cut in, he was just asking for a photo.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.en: I don't know, I just... it bothered me, that's all.

dialogues.question: 용우가 낯선 남자의 말에 끼어든 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo cut in on the stranger's question?
dialogues.correct_answer: 손님이 신경 쓰여서 은근히 질투가 났기 때문
options: 손님이 신경 쓰여서 은근히 질투가 났기 때문
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 정확한 이유를 말하지 못했지만, 손님이 신경 쓰여 은근히 질투가 난 모습을 보였습니다.
